primary_reference.author: J. Marcos Alonso
primary_reference.title: Modelling, Control and Simulation of DC-DC Converters
primary_reference.note: Cited as a theoretical reference with the author's permission. Every blueprint in this pack is a repo-owned, clean-room description of standard continuous-conduction-mode converter theory; no schematic, netlist, or source files from the referenced repository are copied or redistributed.

blocks.title: Buck Converter (step-down)
blocks.summary: Non-isolated step-down converter; output voltage equals the input scaled by duty cycle D.

blocks.title: Boost Converter (step-up)
blocks.summary: Non-isolated step-up converter; output voltage equals the input divided by (1 - D).

blocks.title: Buck-Boost Converter (inverting)
blocks.summary: Non-isolated inverting converter; output magnitude equals the input scaled by D / (1 - D).

blocks.title: Flyback Converter (isolated)
blocks.summary: Galvanically isolated single-switch converter; a buck-boost with a coupled inductor whose output equals the input scaled by n * D / (1 - D).

blocks.title: Forward Converter (isolated)
blocks.summary: Galvanically isolated buck-derived converter with an LC output filter; output equals the input scaled by n * D, with no right-half-plane zero.

blocks.title: Half-Bridge Converter (isolated)
blocks.summary: Galvanically isolated buck-derived converter; two switches drive the transformer across an input-capacitor divider, giving the output n * D / 2 with no right-half-plane zero and a self-resetting core.

blocks.title: Full-Bridge Converter (isolated)
blocks.summary: Galvanically isolated buck-derived converter; four switches in an H-bridge drive the full input across the transformer, giving the output n * D with no right-half-plane zero. Each switch blocks only Vin.

blocks.title: Push-Pull Converter (isolated)
blocks.summary: Galvanically isolated buck-derived converter; two switches drive a center-tapped primary, giving the output n * D with no right-half-plane zero. Dynamically identical to the full-bridge but each switch blocks 2 * Vin.
